attack: Strike, then. Every blow is entered in a ledger you cannot see.
Make it a good answer. The question rarely comes twice.
Remember who taught you to swing. Remember who taught them.
Violence was not invented here. It was only practised well.
A blade is a small thing against a long history. Use it precisely.
The wise struck only once, when once was enough.
Be sure. A missed blow is the one best remembered.
Some things were buried for reasons. You are about to ask why.
stealth: Quiet, then. The forgotten places reward the unseen.
Footsteps are a kind of prayer. Do not pray loudly.
The ground hums under hurried feet. Slow them.
The old rulers governed by being unwitnessed. Borrow the trick.
Shadow is older than law here. Become its student.
Breath, blade, buckle. Silence each before the next step.
Some guardians listen with more than ears. Keep your intent quiet too.
A good thief leaves only a question behind. Leave less than that.
diplomacy: Words, then. This place has buried armies. It has buried fewer envoys.
Speak carefully. Whole empires were built on a single sentence.
Every faction listens for one word in particular. Find theirs.
A question opens more doors than a blade. The old orders knew it.
Promise nothing the dark could overhear. It collects on the unspoken.
Old tongues carry weight. Use new ones with care.
Names have weight here. Spend them like coin.
escape: Run. This place does not begrudge a wise retreat.
Everything that stayed was outlived. Follow the example.
Leave the ruin what it wants. Take what you can still carry.
There is a door behind you. There is usually a door behind you.
Even the great fled, once. They simply did not call it that.
Save what survives. Mourn what does not. In that order.
Fortune marks the swift kindly. Sometimes.
Distance is a currency here. Spend it well.
investigate: Look. The answers were left in plain sight, behind layers of ruin.
Every surface here was once a page. Most are torn now.
Trust the mark before the rumour.
Truth shifts the colour of a thing. Watch closely.
Patience reveals more than torchlight in these places.
Some questions only the dust will answer.
Whatever was guarded here was guarded for a reason. Find it first.
rest: Rest. These places are patient with the still.
Even the great slept. The world simply called it eras.
Close your eyes only as far as you can afford.
A rested mind fares better here. Marginally.
Sleep here is a small trespass. Be a quiet guest.
The world does not pause. You may.
A camp is a small kingdom. Set its borders carefully.
Dreams here are not always your own. Notice whose they are.
travel: Walk, then. The map was never the territory here.
The roads all lead down, eventually.
Watch the horizon. It lies less than the ground.
Every step is a small wager against the road.
Better mapmakers than you died charting less. Move with their care.
Storms favour the hurrying. Do not hurry.
Distance is older than direction here. Mind both.
A traveller is just a relic that has not stopped moving.
cast: Channel cleanly. A sloppy working is worse than a missed blow.
Those who lived longest spent power like blood. Spend it slower.
The power is not yours. It is loaned, with interest.
Each working writes a small letter to the dark. Be brief.
Others felt it tear. So will you, in time.
Worlds have fallen to one cascade too many. Yours need not.
Hold the working in mind before you hold it in hand.
Power answers. Then power answers back.
use_relic: A relic remembers its first owner. Be respectful in introductions.
Greater hands made these. Then misjudged them. Mind the lesson.
Some things wake only to the right touch. Hope yours is right.
Many relics work. Few work as advertised.
Others sell these without warnings. I will not.
Switch it on with care. Switching it off is the harder trick.
There is no kindness left in these objects. Only purpose.
Hold the relic. Do not be held by it.
wait: Wait. What you chase moves when you stop chasing it.
These places reveal themselves to the still.
Listen. This place speaks rarely, and quietly.
Stillness is a stance. Take it well.
The world is in no hurry. Match it.
Sometimes the door opens when you stop knocking.
A held breath has saved more expeditions than any blade.
